baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form-II active-participle plural al-mukadhdhibin at focus word 3 names agents of takdhib, not merely bearers of an incorrect idea.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus root's declaring-false branch makes denial a counterverdict imposed on a report or its bearer; the dative phrase assigns the day's woe to the agents of that verdict.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing or its bearer false supplies the active counterverdict encoded by the focus agent noun.

changed_reading.before: Woe that day to people who lie.
changed_reading.after: Woe that day is assigned to agents who actively pronounce a message, messenger, or event false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same plural agent noun at word 3 can carry the root inventory's scope of falsehood in both speech and action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Falsehood is treated as enacted contradiction: the named group can falsify a truth claim by conduct as well as by an explicit proposition.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood opposed to truth, including falsehood in action, broadens the focus category from speakers to enactors.

changed_reading.before: The condemned group holds or voices a false belief.
changed_reading.after: The condemned group repeatedly makes itself contrary to truth in what it says or does.

context_deltas.mechanism: A reminder is delivered so as to exhaust excuse and awaken caution; the promised matter then lands at a judgment that separates truth from falsehood. Takdhib is therefore not denial of an inert proposition but a counterverdict that the announced event will itself overturn.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a report false anchors the focus reading as a counterverdict awaiting adjudication.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the communicated notice against which denial acts.
Full notification reaching its limit makes delivery function as the exhaustion of excuse.
Warning that frightens and awakens caution gives the reminder an anticipatory function.
An appointment fixing a promise to a time or place turns warning into a scheduled claim.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the promised claim's conversion into settled event.
A judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the event's adjudicative endpoint.

structural_cues: 77:5-7 moves from a cast reminder, through excuse or warning, to the assertion that the promised matter will occur.
77:11-14 fixes the messengers to an appointed Day of Separation immediately before the focus line.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, warning, promise, occurrence, and separation; I infer a verification pipeline in which notice becomes the event that adjudicates its denial. A live alternative is that these are parallel signs rather than causal stages.

changed_reading.before: The deniers reject a threatening report.
changed_reading.after: The deniers issue a counterverdict against fully delivered notice, but the scheduled event will land and separate their verdict from truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical focus clause returns after successive exhibits. Each recurrence keeps the same agent label while changing the immediately preceding evidence, so the label accrues counts rather than naming one isolated refusal.

activation_trace.role: The initial declaring-false agent noun establishes the verdict-formula whose later copies accumulate force.
The first exact recurrence reapplies the declaring-false verdict after the destruction sequence.
A middle recurrence carries the same verdict across the compelled encounter and fire imagery.
The final recurrence reapplies the verdict after bodily refusal, completing its cumulative span.

structural_cues: Each recurrence follows a different proof, consequence, contrast, or refused command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition across changing blocks; I infer that recurrence works as a ledger that adds evidentiary charge. It could instead be a refrain that resets without semantic accumulation.

changed_reading.before: The line is one self-contained curse after the Day of Separation is named.
changed_reading.after: The line is a mobile verdict that repeatedly registers a new manifestation of declaring truth false.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured formation from a weak fluid, containment to a limit, an earth that gathers, fixed supports, and supplied water form a material system of calibration and care. The refrain makes denial a false assessment contradicted by the denier's own embodied and ecological conditions.

activation_trace.role: Declaring something false anchors the model as an adverse assessment of presented evidence.
Estimating and proportioning a thing supplies calibration at the denier's origin.
Lowliness and weakness make the starting material an unlikely basis for self-sufficient denial.
A measure by which a thing reaches its limit supplies bounded development rather than accident.
Gathering and gripping in a receptacle makes the earth a containing system for living and dead.
Fixity and rootedness supply stable support within that containing system.
Giving drink supplies the system's life-preserving flow.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 encloses human origin in a secure receptacle until a known measure.
77:25-27 depicts earth holding living and dead while bearing fixed heights and fresh water, then the refrain returns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured origin, containment, stability, and water; I infer that the refrain treats this infrastructure as counterevidence to the deniers' verdict. A live alternative is that the sequence displays power and favor without specifically recoding takdhib as failed assessment.

changed_reading.before: The deniers reject a verbal claim about judgment.
changed_reading.after: The deniers falsely assess a claim already rehearsed in their own measured formation and in the world that contains and sustains them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The object once declared false becomes the commanded destination. Unimpeded departure leads not to escape but to a nominal shelter that cannot protect or suffice against flame, turning denial from a speech position into an entered consequence.

activation_trace.role: The focus agent noun anchors the model in the act of declaring the coming object false.
The explicit object of their former declaring-false act identifies what now becomes their destination.
Departure without detention supplies the compelled transit toward the denied object.
Shade as shelter and protection supplies the apparent refuge whose function is immediately negated.
Sufficiency supplies the protective capacity that the shade explicitly lacks.
The tongue and ignition of flame supply the threat against which the apparent refuge fails.

structural_cues: 77:29 commands movement toward 'what you used to declare false,' directly reversing distance from the denied object.
The repeated command in 77:29-30 terminates in a three-branched shade that 77:31 denies both shade and protective efficacy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command, denied object, apparent shelter, failed sufficiency, and flame; I infer the directional arrow by which a prior verdict becomes a compulsory destination. The alternative is a consequence scene that does not redefine the act of denial itself.

changed_reading.before: The deniers verbally reject a future punishment while remaining outside it.
changed_reading.after: The deniers are those whose rejected object becomes their route and destination, where even the offered appearance of refuge reverses into exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Takdhib begins as a speech-act that assigns falsehood. In the gathered separation scene, speech is absent, permission for excuse is withheld, and every counter-scheme is challenged; the deniers lose the procedural means by which their earlier counterverdict operated.

activation_trace.role: Declaring another report false supplies the prior counter-speech that is later disabled.
Articulate speech supplies the capacity explicitly absent on that day.
Permission to act supplies the procedural authorization explicitly withheld from them.
Excuse and exculpation supply the defensive speech they cannot offer.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the governing decision rather than their counterverdict.
Joining the dispersed into one gathering supplies the public field in which the decision applies.
Scheme and stratagem supply the last proposed countermeasure, which is openly challenged.

structural_cues: 77:35-36 negates both speaking and permission to excuse before the refrain returns.
77:38-39 names the Day of Separation, gathers former and later peoples, and challenges any remaining scheme.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies silence, withheld authorization, excuse, gathering, separation, and challenged scheme; I infer a procedural reversal of the deniers' earlier speech-act. A live alternative is a public confrontation rather than a juridical hearing.

changed_reading.before: The deniers are people who once spoke against the report.
changed_reading.after: The deniers are counter-speakers whose power to assign falsehood is revoked when they are gathered under a separating verdict and cannot answer, excuse, or evade it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The protected receive real shelter and untroubled recompense, while the criminals are told to enjoy only a little. The focus root's image of expected milk that fails to last turns denial into a wager on apparent provision or protection whose promised duration collapses.

activation_trace.role: Milk expected to continue but failing supplies the focus root's image of disappointed duration.
Shelter and protection supply the genuine cover granted to the protected group.
Repelling harm by protection confirms that this shade performs rather than merely appears.
Enjoyment without hardship or ill effect supplies durable, non-deceptive consumption.
Recompensing an act with its due result supplies the basis of the protected group's enjoyment.
An extended allowance for enjoyment supplies the duration that the next modifier sharply limits.
Smallness and paucity contract the criminals' enjoyment into a failing short term.

structural_cues: 77:41-44 gives the protected shade, springs, desired fruit, and wholesome consumption as recompense.
77:46 echoes the eating command but restricts the criminals' enjoyment with 'a little.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies genuine protection, wholesome recompense, and explicitly brief enjoyment; I infer a transfer from failed duration in the focus branch to the deniers' practical wager. The live alternative is a reward-punishment contrast with no semantic transfer to takdhib.

changed_reading.before: The deniers make a false statement about what will happen.
changed_reading.after: The deniers stake themselves on a provision and protection whose apparent promise does not last, unlike recompensed shelter that actually performs.

context_deltas.mechanism: A spoken command to lower the head meets an embodied refusal. Because the focus inventory includes falsehood in action, the unbent body becomes a visible enactment of takdhib rather than merely a separate act of disobedience.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in speech or action anchors the extension of the focus category into bodily conduct.
Uttered speech supplies the directive against which conduct is tested.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the concrete action commanded and then withheld.

structural_cues: 77:48 places the passive speech formula 'it is said to them' directly against the imperative and the negated response.
The refrain returns immediately at 77:49, classifying the bodily refusal under the same denier label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a command, a bodily nonresponse, and the immediate refrain; I infer that refusal exemplifies action-level falsehood. A live alternative is that disobedience is evidence of denial but not part of its meaning.

changed_reading.before: The deniers contradict the message with words or belief.
changed_reading.after: The deniers also contradict it somatically: their refusal to lower themselves makes the body's posture a counterstatement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing question opposes renewed discourse to heart-settling assent and places every candidate report after this one. The denier label expands from rejection of one item to an epistemic posture for which the sequence has exhausted later alternatives.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the present report false anchors the posture tested by the final question.
Speech renewed as news supplies any hypothetical alternative discourse.
Temporal after-ness places every proposed alternative on the far side of the present message.
Assent in which the heart becomes tranquil supplies the response that no later report is expected to produce.

structural_cues: 77:50 is the surah's final line and asks which discourse after this one they will trust.
The question follows the last occurrence of the refrain at 77:49, making belief the explicit inverse horizon of takdhib.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a final rhetorical question linking later discourse and assent; I infer closure of the deniers' epistemic alternatives. It may instead intensify blame without asserting literal incapacity to assent later.

changed_reading.before: The deniers reject this particular warning.
changed_reading.after: The deniers occupy a terminal posture: after rejecting this sequence, no merely later discourse has an evident route to heart-settled assent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the root inventory's charge-or-attack idiom into the form-II agent noun. It remains anchored in focus branch B004 and is activated by the explicit counter-scheme challenge at 77:39; downstream prose should present it as a performance metaphor, not as the lexical gloss of al-mukadhdhibin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 3 carries a root branch in which a charge proves true by being carried through and proves false by failing.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves false by not being carried through recasts denial as failed performance.
War and combat supply the explicit challenge that tests whether the deniers' countercharge can be carried through.

changed_reading.before: The deniers reject the report by assertion.
changed_reading.after: The deniers mount a countercharge whose claim to truth fails when they are challenged to carry it through.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a dyed cloth whose appearance lies is a remote material image and the focus noun denotes people. It remains anchored in focus branch B009 and gains a visible mechanism from the shade that advertises but cannot supply protection; downstream prose should use it only as an analogy for enacted denial, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 3 carries a branch image of patterned or dyed cloth that deceives by its displayed state.

activation_trace.role: A cloth whose visible state deceives supplies a material analogy for false appearance.
Shade as shelter and protection supplies the apparent promise displayed by the three-branched cover.
Sufficiency supplies the function that the displayed cover fails to perform.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a false assertion made by a person.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be analogized to a displayed state that advertises cover while furnishing none, so appearance itself performs the falsehood.

strongest_changes: Exact recurrence turns 77:15 from an isolated curse into a cumulative verdict applied after distinct kinds of evidence and refusal.
The command to enter what was denied converts takdhib from distant counter-speech into a destination and experienced consequence.
The speech shutdown and refusal to bow expose denial as both procedurally reversed speech and embodied counterstatement.
Measured origin and sustaining containment make denial read as a false assessment contradicted by the denier's own material conditions.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the repeated focus line act as a movable classifier: verbal counterverdict, material misassessment, failed refuge, silenced defense, and bodily refusal remained distinct readings while sharing the same focus anchor.
remaining_uncertainties: The initial sequence may be a causal delivery-to-verdict pipeline or a set of parallel signs.
The cumulative-ledger effect of the refrain is structurally strong but recurrence could function as a reset after each block.
The failed-duration, failed-charge, and deceptive-cover readings are branch-grounded analogies, not secure lexical replacements for the focus noun.
